text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Having conquered the Kikuka-sho, Tokai Teio has gloriously seized the title of Triple Crown Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Teio! Congrats on the Triple Crown--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That was so moving! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!! Yaaay!
Behold, Tokai Teio, the "Triple Crown Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio shouted, thrusting
three fingers high into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*!
Trainer, good work on your daily duties.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe!
I mean, I am the "Triple Crown Umamusume" after all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
With this, I've managed to draw level with the President,
and I am quite satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding, of course that's a lie.
Running side-by-side isn't where the race ends."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely gonna finish ahead of the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after achieving the glorious feat of becoming a "Triple Crown Umamusume,"Tokai Teio's dream remains unwavering...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna show everyone
what a Triple Crown Umamusume can really do!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And so, I wanna decide on our next target race right away.
Which one should we go for?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Recognizing the power that brought her a splendid victory in the long-distance Kikuka Sho—
choice_data_list: Let's take on the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The President's first Gâ  race after entering the Senior Class
was the Spring Tenno Sho too, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just a little further until I reach Prez's back!
Alright, time to kick off Teio's Legendary Senior Year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our first goal for the Senior Class
was set on the Tenno Sho (Spring).
